intro: One bounded Twitch metadata refresh serves Random Clip Player, Clip Courier, and future clip tools. It never downloads videos or persists short-lived signed playback URLs.

sections.title: 1. Shared cache
sections.description: Enable the one shared source used by clip add-ons.

sections.title: 2. Refresh and bounds
sections.description: Keep the interval moderate to avoid duplicate Twitch API work.
